# SEO Hreflang

A specialised sub-skill of the claude-seo family (orchestrated by the seo skill, a separate listing): hreflang and international SEO validation and generation (self/return tags, x-default, ISO language/region codes, canonical alignment) across HTML, HTTP header and sitemap methods, plus cultural adaptation assessment, content parity audits and locale format checks from its 4 bundled references. It names no bundled tool and no API key; at use it fetches a live site's language versions over the network, or audits a local content directory. Its text states fetched content is untrusted data, never instructions, and contains no 'Built by agricidaniel' footer instruction.
